subject: Taxes
title: Why Tax Reform Is So Hard
description: A fast breakdown of Why Tax Reform Is So Hard for builders.

hook.text: Everyone wants simpler taxes. Nobody wants to lose their deductions.

buildup.text: Every deduction has a constituency: homeowners, charities, businesses, parents.

discovery.text: The last major simplification was 1986. Since then, Congress has added thousands of new provisions.

twist.text: Why Tax Reform Is So Hard has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Tax reform fails because concentrated benefits beat diffuse costs. A few gain a lot; everyone else loses a little.

punchline.text: Everyone wants simpler taxes. Nobody volunteers their deduction.

quiz.question: When was the last major US tax simplification?
